mentions.name: Astrolabe
mentions.description: A semantic layer for Nextcloud composed of two open-source services: a Nextcloud app (Astrolabe) and an MCP server backend (nextcloud-mcp-server) that keeps a vector database in sync with Nextcloud content to enable semantic queries. Usable as an MCP server across a number of apps and primarily for semantic search over large numbers of documents, with support for notes, deck cards, files, RSS news items, cookbook recipes, and contacts & calendar, and more apps being added. An EU-based managed offering is also in the works.
mentions.problem: Individuals and teams that already use Nextcloud want to be able to use semantic search across some or all of their documents.
mentions.audience: Individuals and teams that already use Nextcloud and want semantic search across some or all of their documents.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a semantic layer for Nextcloud: https://astrolabecloud.com

The service is composed of two open-source services, namely a Nextcloud app (Astrolabe) and backend (nextcloud-mcp-server). I use the service as an MCP server across a number of apps, and others use it primarily for semantic search over large numbers of documents.
